questions.question: In February 2021, the Finance Minister of India announced the setting up of a Dispute Resolution Committee (DRC) for taxpayers with taxable income up to _______ and disputed income up to _________ .
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rs. 50 lakh, Rs. 10 lakh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Dispute Resolution Committee to be set up for taxpayers with taxable income up to** Rs. 50 lakh and disputed income up to Rs. 10 lakh.**
 
• In the Union Budget 2021-22, the Union Finance Minister-Nirmala Sitharaman reduced the time limit for the reopening of income tax assessment cases from six years to three years.
 
• The time limit will be 10 years for serious tax fraud cases where concealment of income is Rs 50 lakh or more with the approval of the Principal Chief Commissioner.
 
• The tax department will notify rules to remove hardships of double taxation faced by non-resident Indians (NRIs).
 
• She also announced that senior citizens above 75 years of age having an only pension and interest income would not be required to file income tax returns.
 
 
• Banks paying the interest would deduct the tax on their behalf. 
 
 
 
• 1.10 lakh taxpayers have availed of the **Direct Tax Vivad Se Vishwas scheme** to resolve tax disputes.

questions.question: The process of wastewater treatment is commonly called ______ treatment.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**sewage.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The process of wastewater treatment is commonly called **sewage treatment.**

 
• Cleaning of water is a process of removing pollutants before it enters a water body or is reused.
 
• There are mainly three types of sewage treatment stages primary, secondary or biological, and tertiary sewage treatments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Primary treatment (Physical process):

 
 
• It is the process of physically removing small and large particles from sewage.
 
• The floating debris is first removed by filtration through wire mesh screens in a sequential filtration.
 
 
 
• Secondary or biological sewage treatment:
 
 
• It is the removal of biodegradable organic matter from sewage or similar types of wastewater.
 
• This is usually done with the help of microorganisms, hence it is called biological treatment.
 
 
 
• Tertiary treatment (Chemical process):
 
 
• Biological treatment precedes chemical treatment in the treatment process.
 
• Chemical treatment is now considered as a tertiary treatment that can be more broadly defined as “treatment of wastewater by a process involving chemical treatment”.

questions.question: With reference to the Constituent Assembly, which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: The Constituent Assembly adopted the National Anthem in January 1950.
The Constituent Assembly adopted the National song in January 1948.
The Constituent Assembly adopted the National Flag in July 1949.
The Constituent Assembly ratified India's membership of the Commonwealth in May 1947.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The Constituent Assembly adopted the National Anthem in January 1950.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The National Flag **of the Indian Union was adopted on** 22 July 1947.**
 
• **The National Anthem** of the Indian Union was adopted on **24 January 1950.**
 
• The Constitution was passed and adopted by the assembly on **26 November 1949.**
 
• On 24 Jan1950, The Indian Constituent Assembly adopted "Vande Mataram " as a national song.
 
• **The Constituent Assembly** ratified India's membership of the Commonwealth in** May 1949.**
 
 
• **Hence, Statement one is correct.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The Constituent Assembly was constituted in November 1946 under the scheme formulated by the Cabinet Mission Plan.
 
• The elections to the Constituent Assembly were held in July-August 1946.
 
• The Constituent Assembly held its first meeting on December 9, 1946.
 
• Dr Sachchidanand Sinha, the oldest member, was elected as the temporary President of the Assembly, following the French practice.
 
• On December 13, 1946, Jawahar Lal Nehru moved the historic Objectives Resolution in the Assembly that laid down the fundamentals and philosophy of the constitutional structure.

questions.question: As per the Hindu Succession Act 1956, who amongst the following has the first right over the property of a Hindu woman who dies intestate?

options.text: The legal heirs of her husband
The legal heirs of her father

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Her husband.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **As per the Hindu Succession Act 1956, Her husband has the first right over the property of a Hindu woman who dies intestate.**
 
• The Hindu Succession (Amendment) Act, 2005 (39 of 2005) was enacted to remove gender discriminatory provisions in the Hindu Succession Act, 1956.
 
• Under the amendment, the daughter of a coparcener shall by birth become a coparcener in her own right in the same manner as the son.
 
• The daughter shall now have the same rights in the coparcenary property (ancestral property of the Hindu undivided family) as a son.
 
• This amendment also repeals Section 23 of the Hindu Succession Act which disentitled a female heir to ask for partition in respect of a dwelling house, wholly occupied by a joint family, until the male heirs choose to divide their respective shares.
 
• Section 24 of the Act which denied the rights of a widow to inherit her husband's property upon her re-marriage has been repealed.
 
• This Act has brought about a central amendment that is applicable to all state governments.

questions.question: The 'Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay Sanrakshan Abhiyan' (PM-AASHA) has________ components to rationalise the government agricultural produce price and policy for efficiency, savings by way of reduction of wastages and leakages in storage and make fiscal gains.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**three.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **'Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay Sanrakshan Abhiyan' (PM-AASHA)** has **three **components to rationalise the government agricultural produce price and policy for efficiency, savings by way of reduction of wastages and leakages in storage and making fiscal gains.
 
• It is a scheme that guarantees a **Minimum support price (MSP)** to the farmers.
 
• The scheme is an effort of the government’s commitment to ensure remunerative prices to farmers for their produce as announced in the **Union Budget for 2018. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The scheme comprises three sub-schemes:**

 
 
• Price Support Scheme (PSS)

 
 
• ​Under this, physical procurement of pulses, oilseeds, and Copra is to be done by Central Nodal Agencies in collaboration with state governments.
 
 
 
• Price Deficiency Payment Scheme (PDPS)
 
 
• ​This is based on the recommendations of NITI Aayog which suggested “Price Deficiency Payment” for implementation of MSP in crops where procurement is poor.
 
• Direct payment of the difference between the MSP and the selling price will be made to pre-registered farmers selling their produce in the notified market yard and thus it does not involve any physical procurement.
 
 
 
• The pilot of the Private Procurement & Stockist Scheme (PPPS)
 
 
• Under this scheme, participation of the private sector in procurement operations will be piloted.
 
• States have the option to roll out the scheme on a pilot basis in selected districts/APMCs involving private stockists.

questions.question: Which of the following statements is correct with respect to chordates?

options.text: Heart is dorsal or laterally placed or absent
A post anal tail is absent

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Notochord is present.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__** 

 
• **Characteristics of Chordates Are:**

 
 
• Presence of Notochord: 

 
 
• In the embryonic stage of chordate animals, there is a solid stick-like structure (Just below the central nervous system and above the alimentary canal), this is called the notochord.
 
 
 
• Presence of dorsal tubular nerve cord: 
 
 
• In chordates, the nervous system is present at the dorsal surface of the body. The nerve cord is the hollow, tubular structure present just below the body wall and above the notochord.
 
 
 
• Presence of pharyngeal gill clefts: 
 
 
• In every chordate, there is a presence of a pair of lateral gill clefts in the wall of the pharynx for respiration.
 
• These may be present in any stage of its life span like in higher chordates gill clefts are present only in the embryonic stage not in adults.
 
 
 
• Post anal tail:
 
 
• It is the post-anal part of the body.
 
• The tail is reduced or absent in many adult chordates.

questions.question: Which of the following is the main cause of 'bad lands'?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Soil erosion.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Badlands** are a type of dry terrain where softer sedimentary rocks and clay-rich soils have been extensively eroded.
 
• Badlands are arid regions where the hills are badly eroded under the action of water due to occasional rainstorms or the flow of river streams.
 
• Gullies and ravines represent them.
 
• Badland is **rugged topography, usually of relatively low relief.**
 
• Badland is associated with the arid and semi-arid regions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Types of Erosion are as follows

 
 
• Rain Drop Erosion - Due to falling raindrops on the soil surface.
 
• Sheet Erosion- Uniform removal of soil in thin layers from the surface.
 
• Rill Erosion - Erosion takes place through numerous narrow streamlets.
 
• Gully Erosion - Occurs due to runoff of surface water causing the removal of soil and forming gullies due to erosion.
 
• Stram Bank Erosion- Nothing but away from banks of a stream or a river.

questions.question: Who is the author of the book, 'Poverty and Un-British Rule in India'?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Dadabhai Naoroji.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Dadabhai Naoroji wrote the book 'Poverty and Un British Rule in India'. 
 
• Dadabhai Naoroji was popularly known as the 'Grand Old Man of India'.
 
• He is the first Indian to become a member of the British Parliament.
 
• He helped found the London Indian Society and East India Association.
 
• In 1885, Naoroji became a vice-president of the Bombay Presidency Association.
 
• He was Congress president thrice, in 1886, 1893, and 1906.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Major writings of Dada Bhai Naoroji were as follows:**

 
 
• Poverty in India
 
• The manners and customs of the Parsees
 
• Condition of India
 
• Admission of educated natives into the ICS
 
• The wants and means of India 
 
 
 
• **An Era of Darkness** is a book written by **Shashi Tharoor**.
 
• **The Light of Asia: The Poem that Defined The Buddha **is a book written by **Jairam Ramesh.**
 
• **The Ancient Wisdom, Man Whence How and Whithera and Man and His Bodies (Dodo Press)** are some books written by** Annie Besant.**

questions.question: Which of the following musical instruments did Dwaram Venkataswamy Naidu play?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Violin.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Dwaram Venkataswamy Naidu used to play the Violin.**
 
• He was probably the first to show that the violin can be used to play Carnatic music as well as other traditional instruments like** Veena.**
 
• He is not just another great musician and violinist of the 20th century, but perhaps the one primarily responsible for solo violin performances.
 
• Naidu used to play the compositions of famous German musicians like** Mendelssohn and Johann Sebastian Bach.**
